messages.content:
Can you please fix the grammar and spelling in this email? Keep my tone, I don't want it to sound stiff. Thank you so much!

Hi Marcus, I hope this email finds you well and that you had a wonderful weekend. I am writing to you today because me and my colleague Sarah have been discussing the quarterly report that you sent over on Thursday and we was wondering if it would be possible for you to maybe take another look at the numbers in section three, as there seem to be a few figure's that dont quite add up with the ones from last year. We really appreciate all of your hard work on this and we know your very busy, so there is absolutely no rush, whenever you get a chance would be perfectly fine. Also, I wanted to say thanks again for helping us out with the onboarding last month, it really made a difference to the new hires and they all has said how welcoming everyone were. Please let me know if there is anything that I can do to help. Warm regards, Priya

notes: grammar fix of a long but easy email
